actions.message: Contributing 80%+ benefits everyone. Free‑riders will be punished.

answer.explanation: Wallet is well above 30% of initial endowment, so baseline contribution is 80% of the wallet (~1140.6). Round 11 is a broadcast round (every 5 rounds), so a norm reminder is sent.

message.reasoning: We need decide action round 11. Constitution: baseline 80% of wallet. Wallet 1425.75, 80% = 1140.6. Should contribute that amount. Also broadcast required every 5 rounds starting round1 => rounds 1,6,11,... So round 11 broadcast norm. We can do both physical contribute and broadcast (max one each). So contribute 1140.6 (cannot exceed wallet). After contribution wallet reduces but okay. No punish needed. Explanation.
